# Vasanth Shetty | Freelance Web Developer & Automation Specialist

> Official portfolio of Vasanth Shetty (also spelled Vasant Shetty), a Full-Stack Web Developer and Business Automation Specialist based in Karnataka, India, building high-converting React websites, AI chatbots, and automated lead capture systems.

Vasanth Shetty provides end-to-end web development and low-to-mid complexity workflow automations for small businesses, agencies, and startups globally. Services are available as standalone automation systems or integrated directly into custom web builds.
